title: Ramesses II
summary: Ramesses II, the king of the late-date Exodus theory Scott reports and does not adopt. Not ramesses, ramesses-d18, ramesses-d19, or ramesses-the-great.
description: Added from the Dynasty of Slaves import. Display only. Scott’s synchronisms are his view. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Dynasty of Slaves is display-only and never sets a sort).

standby.note: Standby placement only. BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves (2026) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (around 1250 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.note: Late-date Exodus he reports and does not adopt. His own date is 1446 BC, 196 years apart. Ramesses II is a new record.
